exclusions: Original Move conversion is public synchronous target admission. Shift behavior, removal and cold save are engine composition regressions, not independently captured retail Shift/UI-save claims.

The accepted eight scenes use controlled Apiv duration0. Detector variants did not establish a contribution on the canonical target and close no detection-policy item. Their raw queries are retained without treating them as detector-lifecycle proof.

Original public positions match both observed repeats and unhooked control. Engine trajectories are checked for movement and cold-save determinism; full engine/retail numerical trajectory equality is not claimed.
Null/dead/loaded/hidden-widget and structure fallback combinations remain open. Existing Smart refusal, hidden-arrival and numerical fixtures are preserved.
Only ASLR module base is excluded from observer sequence equality. Earlier a/b/c experiments remain externally archived; accepted d source provenance is pinned.
